interface.name: droiddeck_refresh_v1

description.summary: panel refresh rates a nested compositor may ask for

interface.description:
A nested compositor paces its clients against the refresh rate of the panel it is shown on. When its clients are held to a frame rate the panel's current rate does not divide evenly, frames are shown for an uneven number of refreshes. This interface lets the nested compositor see every refresh rate the panel can run at its current size and ask for the one that suits the frame rate it is pacing to.
On bind the compositor sends one rate event per refresh rate, lowest first, followed by done. The list is sent again, in full, whenever it changes (a different panel, or a limit the user placed on the panel's rate). The rate the panel is running at is still reported the standard way, through wl_output.mode.
A request is a preference, not a guarantee: the user, the platform or another output mirroring the panel may hold the panel at another rate. The client reads the result from wl_output.mode.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The preference set through this object is dropped.

request.name: set_target
request.description: refresh is the panel rate the client would like, in Hz, taken from the advertised list; 0 withdraws the preference. frame_rate is the frame rate the client holds its content to, in frames per second, or 0 when the content is not held to a rate. The compositor may multiply the content's frame rate itself (generated frames); when it does, it picks the advertised rate that the multiplied frame rate divides evenly instead of the requested one.

arg.name: refresh
arg.summary: wanted panel refresh rate in Hz, 0 for none

arg.name: frame_rate
arg.summary: content frame rate in frames per second, 0 for unpaced

event.name: rate

description.summary: a refresh rate the panel can run

event.description: Sent once per rate, lowest first, in Hz rounded to the nearest whole number.

event.name: done

description.summary: the list of rates is complete

event.description: Ends a list of rate events. The rates received since the previous done replace the earlier list.
